title: extcap: known host checking
description:
LibSSH considers authenticating the server with host keys to be a
mandatory part of good practice[1] (unless GSS-API is used for the
handshake[2], as that does its own host verification and does not
necessarily sent the host keys.)

Implement host key checking against known hosts in ssh-base and use it
in the extcaps that use ssh-base. Add a boolean option to add a new
host key to the user known hosts file and connect.

1 - https://api.libssh.org/stable/libssh_tutor_guided_tour.html#serverauth
2 - https://gitlab.com/libssh/libssh-mirror/-/commit/f13ecf9d742f39e9e8713f7a6d52a755af3991b8

Fix #21470

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
